name: SAS Missing Value Mechanics and Special Missings
description: Rules for SAS standard missing (.), special missings (.A through .Z), character blanks, and sorting behavior.
when_to_retrieve: When migrating SAS conditional logic containing comparisons with missing values or negative numbers
when_not_to_retrieve: When SAS variables are proven strictly positive non-missing
retrieval_guidance: In SAS: `if var < 0` is true if var is missing! In Python: `var < 0` raises TypeError if var is None.
